The Establishments and Authorities Security Department, represented by the Sports Security Section, organized the Second Annual Forum, “Integration of Security and Organizational Roles for the Doha Bank Stars League,” with the participation of representatives from various entities involved in organizing and securing sporting events in the State. The forum was attended by Brigadier General Staff Khalid bin Ahmed Al Thani, Director of the Establishments and Authorities Security Department, and Mr. Hani Taleb Ballan, Chief Executive Officer of the Qatar Stars League.
